text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lecture in Japan by an honorary horse 
girl who had made historic achievements in 
overseas races. I bumped into Hishi Amazon 
at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What a coincidence bumping into you 
here!
choice_data_list: Are you here for the lecture too?
Are you here for the lecture too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, today's speaker is kinda like a 
memorable horse girl for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My mom used to run in overseas races. She 
and that speaker went head-to-head in a GⅠ 
once.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, she showed me a video of 
that race. Both of 'em were crazy amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right from the start, she took the second 
spot in front, and Mom chased close behind 
to mark her! And then, both of them broke 
away on the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They left the rest of the pack way behind 
in a fierce dead heat! Man, that was one 
burning-hot one-on-one duel!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, it's stayed stuck in my 
head ever since I was little! I was so 
excited when I heard I could listen to her 
in person—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The event will begin shortly. Guests in 
the foyer, please proceed to your seats 
and wait."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like it's almost time. Well 
then, let's head inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listened to the honorary horse girl's 
lecture together with Hishi Amazon. The 
content, based on her personal experiences 
with training methods and discipline, was 
full of valuable insights.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But for me, I kinda wish we could've 
heard more about what was going on in her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now, we would like to open the floor for 
questions from the audience. Please raise 
your hand if you have a question.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Yes, pick me, pick me!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Then, the horse girl in red over there. 
We'll pass you the microphone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Um, out of all the races you've run 
so far, what was the hottest, most fiery 
race you ever had?

text_block_list.name: Honorary Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
The most fiery race? Why, of course, it 
would be the race where I lost by one and 
a half lengths.

text_block_list.name: Honorary Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Even though I lost, that race left me 
feeling completely fulfilled. The one who 
edged past me from behind was... yes. A 
horse girl with straight, resolute eyes 
just like yours.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ! Whoa, hold on, that race is...

text_block_list.name: Honorary Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Contesting against her was genuinely 
thrilling! Come to think of it, chasing 
that excitement again was what kept me 
running all the way until retirement.

text_block_list.name: Honorary Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I only ran against her that single time. 
And yet, meeting someone I could truly 
call a "comrade-in-arms" was a priceless 
treasure in my life!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Comrades-in-arms, huh... Maybe that's why 
I've always loved one-on-ones so much.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The expressions on Mom and her rival's 
faces in that video were just so insanely 
good, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I bet as a kid, I was just super jealous 
of that. Without even realizing it myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's probably why I got so hyped the 
first time I went to watch a race live.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to have fiery one-on-ones like 
Mom and her rival, and make 
"comrades-in-arms" of my own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon spoke with deep, heartfelt 
emotion. Just as she said, at the root of 
her love for one-on-ones might be a simple 
desire for genuine companionship.
choice_data_list:
In that case, everyone at the academy is 
your comrade-in-arms.

text_block_list.text:

as she said, at the root of her love for 
showdowns, there might just be a longing 
for true friends.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to them, every single day is 
a blast! Each and every one of 'em is 
crazy strong...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaahhh! Just talkin' about it is 
makin' my blood pump!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's head straight back to the 
academy! Time for another showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Someday, I'm gonna show ya a 
fiery showdown just like the ones Mom and 
the others had!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Now that that's settled, 
roadwork all the way back!!

With fighting spirit blazing for her 
"comrades-in-arms," Hishi Amazon dashed 
off into the setting sun.
